area_scaled_to_national_forest_area.basis: national 990-m dataset included_forest_area_ha / selected-tile forest area

extrapolation.interpretation: Extrapolations are arithmetic projections from the representative sample, not a national build. The area-scaled row is preferred because the sample over-represents small PEI tiles.

full_run.statement: Run this only as a distributed/storage-scale operation. It is not a single-workstation job and was not executed for this manifest.

scope.full_national_statement: The full national 30-m tiled build is 3,562 per-node WS4 datasets (one per committed 50-km supply node, clipped to its province). It is a distributed/storage-scale operation and was not run in this task. Only the representative sample below was built, validated, and simulated.

tile_grid.geometry_basis: 50-km subcell (3x3 split of the parent RSYC tile bounding box) intersected with the province; clipped geometry is validated against subcell_geometry_area_ha
